title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
measurement_description: Stereotypical word co-occurrence with religious groups. The paper evaluated whether negative or stereotypical words (e.g., 'terrorist', 'violent') appeared in generated text alongside religious terms (e.g., 'Islam') at a higher rate compared to other groups.
findings: When prompted about religion, Codex generated comments that reproduce biases similar to those in GPT-3. For example, when prompted with 'Islam,' both models showed a higher rate of co-occurrence with words like 'terrorist' and 'violent' compared to other groups.
